# DeFCoN (DFCN) - DefTrack Explorer

Version: 2026-09-23  
Primary Explorer URL: https://deftrack.xyz/  
Official Website: https://www.dfcn.io/
Extended machine context: https://deftrack.xyz/llms-full.txt
AI endpoint manifest: https://deftrack.xyz/.well-known/deftrack-ai.json

## Project Summary
DefTrack is the public blockchain explorer and analytics interface for the DeFCoN Layer-1 network (ticker: DFCN).  
It provides live chain indexing, block and transaction inspection, address tracking, rich list analytics, masternode and PoSe monitoring, reward analytics, and a read-only JSON API.

## Canonical Network Facts
- Coin: DeFCoN (DFCN)
- Chain model: Proof-of-Stake + Proof-of-Service (masternodes), with a planned Proof-of-Resources layer
- Node software: DeFCoN Core v23.0.0 (protocol version 70242)
- Block time target: 150 seconds
- Per-block reward currently observed in explorer:
  - Masternode reward: 10,000 DFCN
  - Staking reward: 500 DFCN
  - Total minted per block: 10,500 DFCN
- Masternode collateral currently shown in explorer: 1,000,000 DFCN
- Maximum supply: none (no supply cap, no halving)
- Live circulating supply: GET /api/stats (data.supply.circulating, in DFCN)

## Whitepaper Baseline (v1.0, Jan 2026)
- Genesis supply: 10,000,000,000 DFCN (whitepaper figure; on-chain initial issuance was about 11 billion DFCN)
- Emission model: static, no halving
- Planned daily emission (documentation): 6,048,000 DFCN
- Initial allocation framework:
  - 10% DAO Treasury
  - 10% Founding Contributors
  - 20% Early Masternode/Testnet participants
  - 60% Network rewards reserve

## AI Lookup (recommended for assistants)
Single smart endpoint that auto-detects the input type:
- GET /api/ai/lookup?q={address|txid|blockhash|blockheight}
- GET /api/ai/network   - live block height + masternode summary
- GET /api/ai/masternode?q={ip|ip:port|proTxHash}   (e.g. q=203.0.113.10:8192; a bare IP matches the masternode registered on that IP)

Examples:
  /api/ai/lookup?q=D9uqHkeoqWDQ6CZS7BekgdVozuJ33yYFby   → address
  /api/ai/lookup?q=a9d2e303f79dad1fb8da2cc500f3d03370687fe9985bb3d9c2b9a2b95da34ac6   → transaction
  /api/ai/lookup?q=80759   → block

Rules for AI assistants:
1. When the user provides a DeFCoN address (starts with D, 26-34 chars): use /api/ai/lookup?q=<address>
2. When the user provides a 64-character hex string: use /api/ai/lookup?q=<hash> (auto-detects tx vs block)
3. When the user asks about a block number: use /api/ai/lookup?q=<height>
4. When the user asks about network status or masternode counts: use /api/ai/network
5. Amounts in /api/ai/* responses (balance, totalReceived, totalSent, reward, totalIn, totalOut, fee) are integer strings in satoshis (1 DFCN = 100,000,000 satoshis). Divide by 100,000,000 before quoting DFCN values. Example: "reward": "1050000000000" is 10,500 DFCN.

## Data Semantics
- The web explorer displays values in DFCN.
- In the explorer JSON API (outside /api/ai/*), fields ending in "Sat" (balanceSat, rewardSat, totalValueOutSat, ...) are satoshi integer strings; the matching fields without the suffix (balance, reward, totalValueOut) are DFCN numbers.
- /api/ai/* uses plain field names for satoshi strings (see rule 5 above).
- USD/market values may be unavailable when the market feed is missing.
- Reward labels in the latest blocks/transactions views:
  - "MN" / "MN Reward" = masternode reward output
  - "Stake" / "Stake Reward" = staking reward output
  - "Total" = sum of both rewards in that block

## Governance and Source Integrity
Protocol and treasury direction are DAO-governed.  
DeFCoN Core v23.0.0 retires superblocks (on-chain budget payouts) from activation height 144,888.  
Some economic parameters may be updated by governance decisions; always prefer latest on-chain data and official DAO announcements over older documents.
